price_rule: PAXG price = volume-weighted close across frozen pools whose quote_hint is USDC/USDT/DAI; WTIC price from frozen WTIC/USDC pool when USD volume >= $100 else missing
volume_rule: PAXG volume = sum of GeckoTerminal USD OHLCV across frozen Ethereum pools; WTIC volume = frozen pre-event WTIC/USDC pool USD OHLCV only
cutoff: OHLCV day bucket = UTC date of GeckoTerminal candle timestamp

wtic_leg.backing_claim: Issuer claims 1:1 WTI barrel backing via energy receipts; reserve backing treated as issuer claim unless named attestation is attached
